messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: INCIDENT fired (INC-8421)
incidentbot: Service: hosted-inference-us-east | Trigger: high 5xx rate on /v1/generate | Priority: P1 | Escalation policy: inference-oncall
incidentbot: https://pagerduty.example/INC-8421 — Pager link

alex: saw this, getting alerts in my inbox. 5xx spike started ~7:12pm UTC and kept climbing.
alex: looks like redis kv-cache timeouts spiking for tokens=long requests. seen on 3 hosts in pool-A.

maria: primary oncall didn't ack (no response in PD) — PD shows primary timed out. auto-escalated to secondary and then manager. manager (jordan) got the page at 7:19pm.
maria: can someone confirm if the bridge was created? I don't see a bridge link in PD.

olivia: creating bridge now — https://zoom.mock/bridge/INC-8421 (join if you can)
olivia: I'm starting a quick triage: logs, p95 latency, host OOMs.

alex: paste from logs:
```
2024-11-07T19:16:07Z host-a inference/runtime ERROR kv_cache: timeout after 2000ms
2024-11-07T19:16:08Z host-b inference/runtime ERROR grpc: transport closed unexpectedly
2024-11-07T19:17:03Z host-c inference/runtime WARN request: large sequence length 4096
```

maria: PD escalation policy snippet:
```
- primary (2m ack)
- secondary (3m ack)
- manager (3m ack)
- paging: SMS + phone after manager
```

kai-sre: FYI the auto-retry on the router is causing backpressure. we should temporarily disable retries for the affected route to stop amplification.

alex: agreed. disabling retries on /v1/generate for pool-A now.
alex: command run: `redwoodctl routes update --route /v1/generate --retry-policy none --pool pool-A`

incidentbot: PagerDuty: INC-8421 escalated to secondary (maria) at 1719504580 (7:23pm UTC) — no ack yet.

maria: i just got the PD page, ack-ing now. joining bridge.
maria: looking at infra graph — KV timeout correlates with host bounce due to spike in token-length requests ~7:15-7:20. not seeing OOMs.

olivia: quick mitigation plan: 1) scale pool-A by +2 GPU nodes (hot add) 2) disable long-seq requests via temporary policy (reject >2048 tokens) 3) route traffic for enterprise customers to dedicated pool-B as fallback 4) monitor error rate and rollback changes if no improvement

jordan: I'm on the bridge. was paged as manager because secondary did not ack within PD window. good to hear maria is on it now. keep me posted if customer-facing impact increases. I can stay as an escalation contact.

alex: scaling up pool-A now. command:
```
redwoodctl pool scale --pool pool-A --add 2
```

incidentbot: PagerDuty: ACK from maria (secondary) at 1719504642. Manager (jordan) retained as escalation contact.

maria: after scaling and disabling retries, error rate dropped ~70% within 90s. p95 latency lowered from 1.2s to 360ms for normal seq requests. still some tail errors for seq>3000.

maria: rerouting enterprise traffic to pool-B for critical customers rn. status: partial mitigation.

olivia: adding temporary request-size limiter in edge config:
```
edge-config:
  routes:
    - path: /v1/generate
      max_sequence_length: 2048
```

alex: putting a canary to reject large requests with 429 rather than let them amplify queues. pushing rule now.

kai-sre: confirm PD timeline: primary never acked (no response), PD escalated to secondary at +3m, secondary acked at +8m, manager paged at +6m and then got notified. chain behaved as configured but timing caused manager to be paged briefly. we should tune windows for overnight hours so managers aren't paged unless secondary is unreachable for longer.

jordan: agree — let's update escalation window after postmortem. manager pages woke me at dinner :/

maria: customers impacted: approximate 4% of requests from hosted customers received 5xx between 7:16-7:22pm UTC; top 3 tenants saw degraded throughput but no data loss. made ticket INC-8421-CUST for outreach.

olivia: mitigation complete for now: scaling + retry disable + edge limiter. keeping bridge open for 30m for monitoring.

alex: I'll keep an eye on the autoscaler logs to make sure nodes are healthy.

incidentbot: PagerDuty: INC-8421 status updated to RESOLVED by maria at 1719504860 (7:27pm UTC) — note: follow-up postmortem required.

maria: marking action items:
- SRE: tune PD escalation windows for inference-oncall (kai)
- Platform: add request-size guardrails in service config (olivia)
- Runtime: add better KV timeout handling and backpressure mitigation (alex)
- Support: customer outreach for top-3 affected tenants (jordan)

kai-sre: will own the PD policy change, will open a PR and coordinate with oncall rotation.

jordan: i'll coordinate customer comms with support. thanks everyone for quick response. :thumbsup:

olivia: creating postmortem stub: https://redwood-postmortems/INC-8421

alex: good catch by the incidentbot + PD escalation flow, gives the right people in the room quickly. we'll refine timers to avoid early manager pages.

maria: closing bridge. will keep watch for 10m and then sign off.

incidentbot: Note: This thread will be archived in 7 days.
